connector.name: KIP MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Reads a boat's Signal K data and helps an AI assistant design and install KIP dashboards.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package kip-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dillan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SIGNALK_HOST
env.description: Signal K server host name or IP.

env.name: SIGNALK_TLS
env.description: Set true if Signal K uses https/wss.

env.name: SIGNALK_TOKEN
env.description: Signal K token, needed to write dashboards (or use SIGNALK_USER/PASSWORD).

env.name: SIGNALK_USER
env.description: Signal K username, used with SIGNALK_PASSWORD instead of a token.

env.name: SIGNALK_PASSWORD
env.description: Signal K password, used with SIGNALK_USER.

env.name: KIP_URL
env.description: Override where KIP is served, if it is not the default.
